chosen_approach: Reuse own application mapping and owner-policy runner with public Routeval Harness and exact scorer
reason: The existing mapping handles the nested app/charge schema; the package already produces auditable full artifacts and compares fixed-tolerance routing metrics. Reuse avoids rewriting metric definitions.
assistance: Parent supplied follow-up assignment, fixed input location and shared installed environment. No author coaching, other sessions or delegation.
opinion: Would reuse because full artifacts and comparison gates are useful; this stated reason is distinct from measured execution.

timing.method: UTC system clock from the first follow-up tool action to final artifact writing; start resolution one second.

observed_reuse.adaptation: Only batch/audit input location and the audit success-count message changed. Original sources unchanged.
